{"check": "import io
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import dotenv

def test_crlf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\r\nB=keep\r\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\r\n'

def test_lf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\nB=keep\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\n'

def test_mixed_uses_first(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'C', 'x')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=keep\nC='x'\r\n"

def test_empty_file_defaults_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'v')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='v'\n"

def test_no_trailing_newline_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'C', 'x')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=keep\r\nC='x'\r\n"

def test_export_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'v', export=True)
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nexport B='v'\r\n"

def test_backslash_roundtrip_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'a\\b')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB='a\\\\b'\r\n"
    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, interpolate=False)['B'] == 'a\\b'

def test_unset_preserves_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\n'

def test_unset_preserves_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\r\n'

def test_unset_missing_key_no_change(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    res = dotenv.unset_key(p, 'Z')
    assert res == (None, 'Z')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n'

def test_set_key_return(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'')
    assert dotenv.set_key(p, 'K', 'V') == (True, 'K', 'V')

def test_quote_mode_never(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'plain', quote_mode='never')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=plain\r\n"

def test_quote_mode_auto_quoted(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'has space', quote_mode='auto')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB='has space'\r\n"

def test_quote_mode_auto_unquoted(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'alnum123', quote_mode='auto')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=alnum123\r\n"

def test_invalid_quote_mode(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'')
    try:
        dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'v', quote_mode='bad')
        assert False
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_replace_existing_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\r\nB=keep\r\n"

def test_append_after_no_newline_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'x')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\nB='x'\n"

def test_encoding_utf8(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes('A=old\r\n'.encode('utf-8'))
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'héllo', encoding='utf-8')
    assert p.read_bytes() == "A=old\r\nB='héllo'\r\n".encode('utf-8')

def test_get_key_interpolate_false(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=${B}\nB=world\n')
    assert dotenv.get_key(p, 'A', interpolate=False) == '${B}'
    assert dotenv.get_key(p, 'A') == 'world'

def test_dotenv_values_override(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=${B}\nB=file\n')
    monkeypatch.setenv('B', 'env')
    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, override=True)['A'] == 'file'
    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, override=False)['A'] == 'env'
    assert 'B' not in os.environ or os.environ.get('B') == 'env'
"}
